output_list.reason: The mintTokens function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the icoContractAddress to mint unlimited tokens and transfer them to any user-defined address, causing a potentially catastrophic financial loss to the token holders.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows a user to transfer any amount of tokens to any user-defined address, causing a potentially catastrophic financial loss to the token holders.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows a user to approve an arbitrary number of tokens for spender, causing a potentially catastrophic financial loss to the token holders.
